Membranous_Mucous_Gliders.description: Massively elongated ribs supporting vast sheets of highly vascularized, constantly moist skin. Rather than powered flight, they allow the entity to parachute safely from colossal jungle canopies, while doubling as massive cutaneous breathing organs in high humidity.

Interdigital_Gliding_Webs.description: Monstrously expanded webbing between all the unusually long fingers and toes. When all four limbs are splayed mid-air, these four independent mini-parachutes grant staggering, pin-point aerial steering precision.

Vascularized_Patagium_Flaps.description: Loose, extensive folds of skin running seamlessly along the flanks from armpit to groin. When completely stationary on a tree trunk, these flaps perfectly disguise the entity's shadow, turning it invisible.

Cartilaginous_Fin_Wings.description: Pectoral fins that have explosively hypertrophied into massive, manta-ray like wings. Used exclusively to completely breach the surface of the water, rocketing several meters through the air to escape sub-surface leviathans.

Inflatable_Dorsal_Sacs.description: Giant, ultra-thin biological sacks protruding from the back that violently inflate with inhaled air. By aggressively reducing its specific gravity, the entity drifts aimlessly but safely down mountain breezes like dandelion fluff.

Toxic_Warning_Gliders.description: Small gliding membranes that are completely hidden when folded. When expanded, they suddenly flash blinding, hallucinogenic patterns of crimson and jagged black, often startling attacking hawks long enough to escape.

Mucosal_Adhesion_Wings.description: Short, thick gliding membranes that continually exude biological superglue. Unable to achieve long glides, the entity hurls itself across narrow gaps and instantly plasters itself helplessly, but securely, onto the target tree.

Rigid_Osteoderm_Gliders.description: Unlike standard leathery gliding membranes, these flaps contain hundreds of interlocking bony plates. They offer horrific aerodynamics, causing a steep, plunging glide, but form an impenetrable turtle-like shell when wrapped around the body.

Subterranean_Vestigial_Flaps.description: Completely degenerate remnants of ancestral gliding membranes now utterly useless for flight. They merely serve to accidentally pack more dirt around the entity as it struggles mindlessly through the subterranean dark.

Bioluminescent_Flare_Wings.description: Expansive gliding patagia absolutely riddled with millions of incredibly bright symbiotic photophores. During mating season, dozens of entities leap simultaneously from immense cliff faces, illuminating the abyssal chasm in a synchronized, cascading neon waterfall.
